tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover should be greater than atleast twice the cost put to tender that is Rs.4,62,000. In any Two year in the preceding 3 years i.e year 2025-2026, 2024-2024, 2024-2023. Upload the Annual Turnover Certificate from CA with UDIN number should be submitted in technical bid
No Black list certificate on stamp paper should be submitted for the date of submission of tender. Note Old Black list certificate will not be accepted.

Should have registered with Statutory authorities in Karnataka as indicated below and scanned copy of necessary proof to be Uploaded License issued by Labor department or Appropriate Authority.Company or Firm Registration Certificate or Trade Licence from competent authority.GST Certificate
Similar Work Done Certificate from last three years 2025-2026,2024-2024,2024-2023

The tenderer should have valid agreement with first class AC hall accommodating atleast 500 members for conducting program with in 10 KM radius of Udupi CMC office. The agreement for such arrangement should be submitted.

The tenderer should submit agreement with FSSAI Food Standard certified kitchen or food outlet from competent authority within the 10km radius from the Udupi City Municipal Council office.The tenderer should submit both FSSAI certificate and valid Agreement or MOU in technical bid

The tenderer who are applying from outside of Udupi district should have the valid agreement with FSSAI Food Standard certified kitchen/food outlet from competent authority within the 10km radius from the Udupi City Municipal Council office. The tenderer should submit both FSSAI certificate and Agreement/MOU in technical bid.
